title: Certificates of Deposit: repointing interest that is paid to a closed account
content:
## Situation this policy governs

Interest paid out from a Certificates of Deposit certificate must reach an account of the owner that is still open. This policy applies when a certificate's interest is being paid to checking or to savings and the payout account it names has been closed. It governs which payout account the certificate carries on record for its interest. The change is recorded with the tool described below and is visible on the certificate record at once.

## Tool: update_interest_disposition_67b383bc

### What it does

The tool records where a certificate of deposit's credited interest goes and which PCB account receives it. It replaces the certificate's interest disposition and the PCB account named as its payout account. The maturity instruction is left as it is. The change takes effect from the next interest crediting date and is visible on the certificate record at once.

### How it is invoked

update_interest_disposition_67b383bc is an internal tool; the agent unlocks it first and then calls it.

### Parameters

**certificate_id** (identifier) — the certificate reference number whose interest disposition changes, as returned by the certificate lookup for this customer.

**interest_disposition** — where credited interest goes; the complete set of values:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| compound | Interest is added to the certificate's principal |
| pay_to_checking | Interest is paid to the payout checking account |
| pay_to_savings | Interest is paid to the payout savings account |

**payout_account_id** (identifier) — the account reference number of the customer's own PCB checking or savings account to record as the payout account, as returned by the checking or savings account lookup.

### What it returns

A successful call returns a receipt, rendered as text, with certificate_id (the certificate updated), interest_disposition (the disposition now on record), payout_account_id (the payout account now on record) and recorded_at (the moment of the change, exactly as the system clock reads). A receipt echoing the new disposition means the change is recorded.

## Contract questions

**Does the call also change the maturity instruction?**
No. The maturity instruction is left as it is.

**When does a recorded change first affect a crediting?**
From the next interest crediting date.
